evidence.quote:
a. Ord. No. 8544 An Ordinance of the Council of the City of Rittman,

Wayne and Medina Counties and State of Ohio, Extending a Moratorium on the
receipt, processing, issuance and approval of any application for a zoning certificate
for NICS 518-Data processing, hosting and related services (Data Centers) under the
City’s Planning and Zoning Code for an additional 180 days; and declaring an |
| emergency. Three Readings. Ord. No. 8544 was read on first reading. Nelson moved to |

suspend the rules, all Yeas on roll call and motion carried. Huff moved to adopt. Council
| discussed the additional review period, available land, possible future data-center

development, limited employment, water and sewer capacity, and potential conditions or

revenue associated with a project. Huff moved to extend the moratorium to 540 days. Upon |
| roll call Schumacher - No, Huff— Yes, Shows — No, Nelson — No, Sweigert — No, Hayward |

| —No and motion fails. Huff moved to adopt the 180-day extension, all Yeas on roll call and
| motion carried.
